title: Ad Hoc and Farm Bill Payments Impact on Non-Real Estate Farm Debt
abstract:
This study investigates the impact of ad hoc government payments—specifically the Market Facilitation Program (MFP) and Coronavirus Food Assistance Program (CFAP)—and Farm Bill safety net payments—Agricultural Risk Coverage (ARC) and Price Loss Coverage (PLC)—on non-real estate agricultural loan delinquencies in the United States. The goal is to evaluate the relative effectiveness of these payments in alleviating financial stress in the agricultural sector.
We use a state-level panel dataset covering the years 2015–2022 and apply linear fixed effects models to estimate the marginal effect of each payment type on total non-real estate farm debt and delinquency rates. Robustness is assessed using dynamic panel models and Lewbel's IV estimator to address potential endogeneity.
ARC and CFAP payments are significantly associated with reductions in short-term loan delinquencies (30–89 days past due). ARC payments also increase total operating debt, suggesting improved liquidity. PLC payments reduce longer-term delinquencies (90+ days past due), while MFP payments increase total debt but do not reduce delinquencies, indicating weaker effectiveness.
This is the first study to jointly evaluate the effects of ARC, PLC, MFP, and CFAP payments on non-real estate farm debt outcomes using actual payment timing and amounts. It offers novel empirical insights into the financial efficacy of government support programs in agriculture.
abstract_zh:
本研究考察了临时性政府补贴（具体为市场便利计划（MFP）和冠状病毒食品援助计划（CFAP））以及农业法案安全网补贴（具体为农业风险保障（ARC）和价格损失保障（PLC））对美国非房地产农业贷款拖欠情况的影响。研究旨在评估这些补贴在缓解农业部门财务压力方面的相对有效性。
我们使用了涵盖2015年至2022年的州级面板数据集，并应用线性固定效应模型，估计每种补贴类型对非房地产农业债务总额和拖欠率的边际效应。稳健性检验采用了动态面板模型以及Lewbel的IV估计量，以处理潜在的内生性问题。
ARC和CFAP补贴与短期贷款拖欠（逾期30至89天）的显著减少相关。ARC补贴还会增加经营性债务总额，表明流动性有所改善。PLC补贴减少了长期拖欠（逾期90天以上），而MFP补贴虽然增加了债务总额，却未能减少拖欠，表明其有效性较弱。
这是首个利用实际补贴发放时间和金额，联合评估ARC、PLC、MFP和CFAP补贴对非房地产农业债务结果影响的研究。它为农业领域政府支持计划的财务效力提供了新颖的实证见解。

title: Lost Ground, Lost Value: Investigating the Relationship Between Soil Erosion and Agricultural Land Value
abstract: This study examines the impact of soil erosion on agricultural land values in the United States (US) Midwest. Based on a novel county‐level panel data set with information on soil erosion levels and agricultural land values covering five census years (1997, 2002, 2007, 2012, and 2017), we separately investigate the direct effect of two types of soil erosion—water and wind erosion—on county‐level average agricultural land values. Linear panel fixed effects econometric models and a number of robustness checks are used to achieve the study objective. We find that increasing soil erosion levels have a statistically significant negative impact on agricultural land values at the county level. Our findings confirm that damages to the soil from water or wind erosion are capitalized into lower farmland values. The study provides new insights in terms of further understanding the economic damages due to soil erosion and the likely benefits from soil erosion control.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了土壤侵蚀对美国中西部农业用地价值的影响。基于一个新颖的县级面板数据集（包含土壤侵蚀水平与农业用地价值信息，覆盖1997、2002、2007、2012和2017年五个人口普查年份），我们分别考察了水蚀和风蚀两类土壤侵蚀对县级平均农业用地价值的直接影响。研究采用线性面板固定效应计量模型，并进行了多项稳健性检验。我们发现，土壤侵蚀水平的增加对县级农业用地价值具有统计上显著的负向影响。研究结果证实，无论是水蚀还是风蚀造成的土壤损害，都会资本化为较低的农田价值。本研究为进一步理解土壤侵蚀造成的经济损失，以及土壤侵蚀防治可能带来的效益，提供了新的见解。

Dynamically Optimal Cover Crop Adoption
abstract: This paper develops a stochastic dynamic programming model to investigate optimal cover crop adoption policies, accounting for cumulative effects on soil fertility, uncertain future fertilizer and output prices, irreversibility of sunk machinery costs and flexibility in the timing of adoption over time. Based on data from a 35-year cotton field experiment in West Tennessee (1984–2018), we first estimate the static and dynamic yield effects of cover crop adoption and then use these estimates to evaluate the decision of a representative cotton farmer to adopt three cover cropping practices—hairy vetch, winter wheat and crimson clover—under conventional till and no-till production systems. Econometric estimates imply significant cumulative effects of cover crops on yields, as well as static and dynamic substitution effects between cover crops and nitrogen fertilizer inputs. With these substitution effects implying increasing marginal profit from soil fertility, our analysis suggests a threshold level of soil fertility level, above which it is optimal to adopt cover crops and below which it is not. Adoption of cover crops is more favored if no-till practices have been implemented. Moreover, in the presence of sunk costs that have not yet been incurred, the optimal strategy is to postpone the adoption of cover crops in both conventional till and no-till fields until crop prices improve, the cost of adoption decreases, or fertilizer prices increase. Our results also indicate that when fertilizer prices are higher, cover crop adoption in no-till systems can lead to substantial fertilizer cost savings, with the amount of those fertilizer cost savings increasing over time as soil health further improves.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个随机动态规划模型，以研究最优覆盖作物采用政策，该模型考虑了对土壤肥力的累积效应、未来化肥和产出价格的不确定性、已沉没机械成本的不可逆性，以及采用时机的灵活性。基于西田纳西州一项为期35年（1984–2018年）的棉花田间实验数据，我们首先估计了覆盖作物采用的静态和动态产量效应，随后利用这些估计，评估了一位代表性棉农在常规耕作和免耕生产系统下，采用三种覆盖作物种植方式（毛叶苕子、冬小麦和深红三叶草）的决策。计量估计表明，覆盖作物对产量存在显著的累积效应，并且覆盖作物与氮肥投入之间存在静态和动态的替代效应。由于这些替代效应意味着土壤肥力的边际利润递增，我们的分析表明存在一个土壤肥力阈值：高于该阈值时采用覆盖作物为最优，低于该阈值时则不然。若已实施免耕，则采用覆盖作物更为有利。此外，在存在尚未发生的沉没成本的情况下，最优策略是推迟在常规耕作和免耕田地上采用覆盖作物，直至作物价格改善、采用成本下降或化肥价格上涨。我们的结果还表明，当化肥价格较高时，免耕系统中采用覆盖作物可带来可观的化肥成本节约，且随着土壤健康状况的进一步改善，这些节约金额随时间增加。

title: Tennessee Fruit and Vegetable Farmers' Willingness to Adopt Alley Cropping Systems
abstract: Alley cropping is an agroforestry practice that involves the planting of trees or shrubs alongside herbaceous crops within the same production system. Potential benefits of alley cropping include crop diversification, enhanced productivity of annual crops, reduced soil erosion, improved pollinators and wildlife habitat, decreased incidence of pests and diseases, carbon sequestration, and reduced nitrogen leaching. Despite these potential benefits, the adoption of alley cropping remains low. In Tennessee, specifically, only about 2% of the farms have used agroforestry practices, including alley cropping. We surveyed Tennessee fruit and vegetable farmers to assess their willingness to adopt alley cropping and the differences in characteristics of those willing and not willing to use this production practice. In general, those respondents who are willing to adopt alley cropping are more familiar with this production system and are facing or have faced production challenges that could be alleviated by adopting this production practice, such as low organic matter and crop heat stress. Our results also suggest that the type of trees or shrubs incorporated in this system and adequate payment for adoption that covers investment and maintenance costs could affect Tennessee fruit and vegetable farmers’ willingness to use this system.
abstract_zh: 林粮间作（alley cropping）是一种农林复合经营方式，即在同一生产系统内，在草本作物行间种植树木或灌木。林粮间作的潜在益处包括作物多样化、提高一年生作物的生产力、减少土壤侵蚀、改善传粉者和野生动物栖息地、降低病虫害发生率、固碳，以及减少氮素淋溶。尽管有这些潜在益处，林粮间作的采用率仍然很低。具体到田纳西州，仅约2%的农场采用过包括林粮间作在内的农林复合经营方式。我们对田纳西州的水果和蔬菜种植者进行了调查，以评估他们采用林粮间作的意愿，以及愿意采用与不愿采用这一生产方式的农户在特征上的差异。总体而言，那些愿意采用林粮间作的受访者对这一生产系统更为熟悉，并且正面临或曾经面临能够通过采用该生产方式缓解的生产挑战，例如有机质含量低和作物热应激。我们的结果还表明，所纳入系统的树木或灌木类型，以及能够覆盖投资和维护成本的充足补偿，可能会影响田纳西州水果和蔬菜种植者使用该系统的意愿。

title: The Effect of Crop Insurance on Agricultural Loan Delinquencies
venue: Journal of the Agricultural and Applied Economics Association
abstract: This study addresses how participation in the Federal crop insurance program influences agricultural loan delinquencies. To achieve this objective, we use 1994–2015 county‐level panel data for corn production in the Midwestern United States (US). Traditional linear fixed effect (FE) models, instrumental variable‐based FE estimation, and several robustness checks are used in the empirical analysis. Estimation results suggest that counties with higher levels of crop insurance participation tend to have statistically lower rates of agricultural loan delinquency. This is evidence that the US crop insurance program helps reduce financial stress and facilitates the continued viability of the agricultural credit system.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨参加联邦农作物保险计划如何影响农业贷款拖欠。为实现这一目标，我们使用美国中西部玉米生产1994–2015年的县级面板数据。实证分析采用传统线性固定效应（FE）模型、基于工具变量的固定效应估计以及多项稳健性检验。估计结果表明，农作物保险参保率较高的县，农业贷款拖欠率在统计上显著更低。这证明美国农作物保险计划有助于减轻财务压力，并促进农业信贷体系的持续运行。
